title: SelfImprove-Bench: Evaluating Generalization in Self-Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.02797v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursively self-improving (RSI) systems are increasingly viewed as a promising means of accelerating progress toward artificial general intelligence. They aim to autonomously improve their capabilities by refining their working pipelines and recursively improving the strategies that guide subsequent refinements, with gains generalizing to unseen scenarios.However, existing evaluations lack reliable metrics to distinguish capability gains from scenario fitting, sustainable and extensible protocols for unseen tasks and difficulties, and fine-grained attribution of improvement to evolution traces. To this end, we propose SelfImprove-Bench,an RSI evaluation framework that organizes tasks into three primary capabilities (i.e., Exploring, Planning, Reasoning) as scenarios for guiding model evolution. translated_title: SelfImprove-Bench：评估自我改进智能体的泛化能力
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进系统日益被视为加速迈向通用人工智能（AGI）的一条有前景的途径。这类系统旨在通过完善自身工作流程、并递归地改进引导后续完善的策略来自主提升能力，使能力增益能够泛化到未见过的场景中。然而，现有评估缺乏能够区分真实能力增益与场景过拟合的可靠指标，缺乏针对未见任务与难度的可持续、可扩展的评估协议，也缺乏将改进细粒度归因于演化轨迹的手段。为此，我们提出了 SelfImprove-Bench——一个 RSI 评估框架，它将任务组织为三种核心能力（即探索、规划、推理），作为引导模型演化的场景。为了可控性和可复现性，我们在游戏上实例化这些任务，并配套可扩展的任务生成与编排机制（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出 SelfImprove-Bench，一个针对递归自我改进智能体的评估基准，将任务组织为探索、规划、推理三大核心能力场景，并基于游戏实现可控、可复现且可扩展的评估，以解决现有评估无法区分真实能力增益与场景过拟合的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SelfImprove-Bench, an evaluation framework for recursively self-improving (RSI) agents that organizes tasks into three core capabilities—Exploring, Planning, and Reasoning—implemented on controllable, reproducible, and scalable game-based scenarios to distinguish genuine capability gains from mere scenario fitting.
